scope: Smoke only: pool_b is not a held-out team split; 400 games per opponent, greedy, no search, no gate.
selection: lowest standalone holdout policy NLL among R/A/S/B best checkpoints; B epoch8

formulas.switch_rate: selected_by_family.switch / decisions; equivalently sum slots8..12 / decisions; slot13 is forced/default and excluded
formulas.combined_switch_rate: sum switches / sum decisions across both opponents

comparison_limits: Play switch counts include forced replacements, while retained human replay decisions omit forced/single-choice rows. Raw rates are descriptive, not a like-for-like voluntary-switch comparison.

legacy_smoke_reference.source: docs/results-ledger.md, 'replay blueprint learning curve at 1k–20k games'; 400 games/opponent on pool_b

legacy_comparison: Both new smoke Wilson intervals lie wholly above their legacy smoke intervals; this does not establish held-out strength or pass a gate.
decision_timing_and_fallbacks: n/a in the evaluator printed rows; not inferred from total wall.
dirty_scope: Pending measurement documentation/artifacts at launch; application/config/dependency/submodule code matches the reviewed base.
